caption: The drawing shows a centrally placed, symmetrical abstract shape composed mainly of geometric forms. The upper section consists of three adjacent vertical rectangles: the leftmost is black, the central one is red with a scalloped right edge, and the rightmost is green bordered by a deep pink-red scalloped edge. These rectangles are outlined with thin, dashed lines. Below these rectangles, a large semicircular shape extends downward, divided into three zones: an outer light tan or beige ring, a middle turquoise band, and an inner central area that is black with a magenta-pink edge and pointed interior decoration. The drawing is centered on a beige background, and the edges of the central shape are neatly defined, with visible pencil or pastel texture throughout.
title: Moccasin Beadwork
